contract: Every declared GRPO comparison group admitted by VARE replay has one behavior policy ID, one behavior policy version, and one verifier version. Freshness remains evaluated per experience; a uniformly stale group is eligible while within configured lag.
changes_under_test: Atomic replay admission rejects whole groups with mixed policy ID/version or verifier version.
Grouped replay sampling fails closed on legacy mixed-provenance rows.
CapabilityLoop preserves homogeneous current and permitted-stale groups and never calls train_candidate with a mixed policy-version group.
primary_metric: Number of mixed policy-version groups passed to train_candidate (must be zero).
controls: homogeneous permitted-stale [0,0] remains admitted when max_policy_lag=2
atomic replay tests reject mixed policy ID, policy version, and verifier version
legacy grouped replay tests return no mixed-provenance group
independent_oracle: scripts/check_group_policy_provenance_oracle_v1.py; pure Python Fraction enumeration, no VARE or trainer imports.
pass_criteria: all focused engine and replay regressions pass
exact oracle reproduces the frozen target-policy update values 1/4 and 41/100

interpretation_limit: This is a VARE declared-group contract repair. It does not establish that mixed-policy GRPO is generally invalid; prior art explicitly studies mixed and off-policy GRPO.
